Gulf of Chiriquí National Marine Park lies on Panama's western Pacific coast. It brings together protected island and coastal landscapes. White beaches, mangrove areas and the sea create a variety of scenery within the same region.

Trips focus on exploring islands, diving and observing nature. A sea excursion offers views of the coastline from the water and time on individual islands. The park complements mountain travel in western Panama with Pacific coastal experiences, allowing visitors to combine forest excursions with time by the sea.

## Guadalajara — Mexico's "City of Roses"

Guadalajara is the country's second-largest city and the capital of the Mexican state of Jalisco. It is a clean, modern city with well-developed infrastructure. The city was named after Guadalajara in Spain, whose name comes from the Arabic Wād al-Ḥijāra, meaning “River Flowing Between Rocks.” Spanish colonial architecture, particularly Baroque churches, defines Guadalajara's appearance.

## Guadalajara — A Center of Mexican Traditions!

Many traditions now considered quintessentially Mexican originated in Guadalajara. Tequila, mariachi music, sombreros, rodeo and the Hat Dance all have roots here. The city offers many of the attractions associated with Mexico City: vibrant culture, excellent museums and galleries, beautiful historic buildings and exciting nightlife. Guadalajara is also known for its lovely parks and gardens, which earned it the nickname “City of Roses.”

### Guatemala City — Guatemala's Calling Card!

Guatemala City is the capital of Guatemala and the largest city in Central America, located in the southern part of the Republic of Guatemala. It was founded in 1776. The ancient Maya city of Kaminaljuyú once stood on the site of today's metropolis. Today, Guatemala City is the country's largest city and its business and cultural center.

Surrounded by mountains and built along their slopes, the city has narrow streets, numerous parks and bustling, chaotic markets. Seen from above, it resembles a patchwork quilt. Its distinctive appearance, reminiscent of a picture postcard, captivates visitors.

## Guatemala City — Guatemala's Tourist Center

### Guatemala City — A City of Contrasts!

Guatemala City impresses with its contrasts: clusters of modern skyscrapers stand next to historic buildings and ancient temples dating from the colonial period, while the bustle of business districts mixes with the stillness of old ruins. The city attracts visitors with parks, galleries and a variety of museums. Popular landmarks include the National Palace of Culture, the Cathedral and the main shopping center.
